column1: # 1.21.5 (NeoForge 21.5): the harness renames are those of 1.21.4, plus any rows below.
# Measured against neoforge-21.5.98-sources.jar. The annotation-driven GameTest API is gone in 1.21.5 (CATALOG V5/V20/V47):
# that is not a rename -- tools/port_gates.py runs templates/multi-version/tools/gametest_adapter.py (--dialect 1.21.5) over the harness.
# Entity.moveTo -> snapTo (CATALOG V39: all five overloads moved together).
# GameTestHelper.getBlockEntity now takes the expected class; GameTestHelper.fail takes a Component.
# ArmorItem is gone: the slot an armour piece goes in is its EQUIPPABLE component's. (Runs after 1.21.3's `armor.getEquipmentSlot()` row.)
